plugins.name: CMake
plugins.description: CMake presets, Configure with its errors as diagnostics, Build in a terminal tab. Language server: install cmake-language-server yourself (pip install cmake-language-server); t-code's own neocmakelsp wins when it is installed.

plugins.name: Commit Message Helper
plugins.description: Guesses the Conventional Commits type and scope of the staged files (fix(lsp): ...), asks for the subject and fills Source Control's message box. Written in Go, built once with go.

plugins.name: Open on GitHub / GitLab
plugins.description: Copies or opens the web link of the cursor's line or the selected lines, at the current commit, on GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg / Gitea or Bitbucket. Needs Perl 5 and git.

plugins.name: Format on Save
plugins.description: Formats a file when it is saved, where the project configures a formatter (.clang-format, ruff or black in pyproject.toml, .prettierrc, Cargo.toml, .editorconfig for shfmt; gofmt always), as one undo step. Needs the formatter itself; written in Go, built once with go.

plugins.name: Java
plugins.description: jdtls (completion, errors, navigation, refactoring), Run (F5 too), Build, Test and Clean for Maven, Gradle and plain folders, with errors and exceptions as diagnostics. Language server: run Java: Install Language Server once (downloads jdtls; needs a JDK 21+).

plugins.name: LaTeX and Typst
plugins.description: Builds a LaTeX or Typst document when one of its files is saved, with its errors in Problems and its state in the status bar; opens the PDF. Needs latexmk, tectonic or pdflatex, or typst; written in Rust, built once with cargo.

plugins.name: MATLAB
plugins.description: Run .m files in a MATLAB session in a terminal tab (F5 too); run errors show as diagnostics. Needs MATLAB. Language server: install MathWorks' MATLAB Language Server yourself (matlab-language-server on PATH); the rest works without it.

plugins.name: Octave
plugins.description: Run .m files in a GNU Octave session in a terminal tab (F5 too); run errors show as diagnostics.

plugins.name: Pomodoro
plugins.description: A focus timer at the right of the status bar: 25 minutes of focus, then a break (a long one after every fourth), with a desktop notification when each ends. Written in C, built once with the system's C compiler.

plugins.name: ShellCheck
plugins.description: ShellCheck's warnings in the Problems panel and the editor whenever a shell script is opened or saved.

plugins.name: Spell Check
plugins.description: Underlines misspelled words in Markdown and text files and in source files' comments when they open or are saved; fixes the word at the cursor from hunspell's suggestions. Needs hunspell and a dictionary; written in C++, built once with the system's C++ compiler.

plugins.name: Targets
plugins.description: Make, just, Task and npm targets in the picker; the chosen one runs in a terminal tab, its compiler errors land in Problems. Needs Node.js 18 or newer (and make, just or task for their files).

plugins.name: Text Tools
plugins.description: Change case, sort and dedupe lines, base64, URL encoding, JSON formatting, a UUID or a date.

plugins.name: TODO Finder
plugins.description: TODO, FIXME, XXX and HACK comments in the project: pick one to go to it, or list them in the Problems panel. Written in Rust, built once with cargo.

plugins.name: Word Count
plugins.description: The active tab's words and lines at the right of the status bar, unsaved edits included, updated as you type; Ctrl+Alt+W says the selection's count. Written in C++, built once with the system's C++ compiler.
